uncited: It differs from general multi-GPU setups by enforcing a strict 1:1 CPU-GPU affinity to maximize throughput in distributed environments.
Identify the available GPUs and CPU cores on the node.
Establish a static mapping where each GPU is assigned to a specific CPU core.
The CPU core handles disk access and data preparation.
The CPU initiates data transfer to its matched GPU.
- If the number of GPUs exceeds available cores, the matching model breaks down, leading to contention.
- The model scales with the number of matched GPU-CPU pairs.
- Use when running on cluster nodes with multiple GPUs and sufficient CPU cores to maintain 1:1 affinity.
- Not suitable for environments with severe load imbalance or insufficient CPU cores relative to GPUs.
